title: Os Vcs Hub Cqrs Event Sourcing Refactor
description:
Make os, vcs and hub work perfectly together, designed in conjunction, as one coherent local-first CQRS + event-sourcing system.

Apps must emit typed operations (not CRUD) that modify documents instead of snapshotting whole documents. An in-memory graph (per-document DocumentVcsStore) holds live state. A backbone actor per open document, running on another thread (native: std::thread/tokio; browser: dedicated worker), performs all IO (persistence, hub sync, file watching, presence) so the UI is never blocked. The actor proactively ingests external changes: another process editing the file on disk, another author editing the document via the hub server.

Full plan (10 architecture decisions + 6 workstreams WS-A..WS-F + phasing + verification) is at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/make-sure-that-os-gleaming-stonebraker.md. Summary of workstreams:
- WS-A: vcs engine hardening (Backbone becomes non-blocking queue contract, Edit.actor, real UndoPolicy semantics, ChannelBackbone).
- WS-B: framework/sync grows into the actor layer (DocumentHost actor, native thread + browser worker twin, file-watch + hub WS endpoints).
- WS-C: hub v2 (SQLite persistence replacing unwired Postgres, per-document actor mailboxes, duplex WebSocket as primary transport, drop the broken version-precondition on op append, presence, auth-lite).
- WS-D: plugin contract (DocumentApp/ActionEmit/VcsDocumentApp generic wrapper generalizing CAD's pattern into PluginApp; typed HostEffect; WIT changes).
- WS-E: os document topology (app documents become separate vcs documents referenced by handle instead of embedded snapshots) + shell/host wiring (React + wgpu) + dev workflow.
- WS-F: migrate all ~23 plugins from setDocument-snapshot CRUD to typed op emission, in waves (shooting proving pair first, then puzzle/writer/etc, then flow/gis/procedural/etc, then forms/cad/lowpoly/s last).

This is a large multi-week refactor touching ~30 Rust crates plus the React/wgpu renderers and dev tooling. This ticket tracks the whole effort across many implementation sessions.
summary:
WS-F Wave 1 (proving pair) complete: migrated `shooting` and `vcs` demo plugins from the old setDocument-snapshot CRUD pattern to the new typed-operation DocumentApp contract. This ticket tracks the whole multi-workstream OS/VCS/Hub refactor across sessions; this session's contribution was specifically WS-F Wave 1.

**shooting/rs (core crate)**: fully rewritten. Moved the real icon-studio domain (ShootingFixture/Asset/Shot/SavedCamera/Camera/SceneLighting incl. Sun/Ambient/Shadow/Material) out of the plugin into this core crate (old toy ShootingScene/ShootingEntity model deleted outright). Added Identified/Patchable impls + patch structs (ShootingAssetPatch/ShootingShotPatch/ShootingSavedCameraPatch/ShootingScenePatch), the real `ShootingOp` enum (Assets/Shots/SavedCameras as CollectionOp, SetActiveShot/Asset, SetCamera, SetShotCamera, PatchScene, Translate/Rotate/ScaleAssets, SetFixture) with full diff()/backwards() built on vcs's collection_diff_from_op/invert_collection_op. 11 unit tests (per-op round trips + coalesced-camera-drag).

**shooting/plugin/rs**: rewrote ShootingPlayApp as a DocumentApp impl (Projection=ShootingFixture, Op=ShootingOp). Runtime/view-state (selection, camera draft, transform tool) moved into the app struct. Every action converted: doc-mutating actions emit typed ops (single or multi-op per undo step, e.g. import-asset = Add+SetActiveAsset in one edit); setCamera coalesces via coalesce_key; save/load/export actions emit HostEffect (DownloadMediaExport/RequestFileOpen/IconRenderExport) instead of fake ops. Deleted ShootingPlayEnvelope, parse_envelope/set_document_op, ShootingFixtureEditOp/apply_fixture_edit, manual undo/redo handling, and all quat/scale math (moved to core). Added full .operation()/.view_action()/.shell_action() registry (previously undeclared). 27 tests, including the definitional regression proof: two independent VcsDocumentApp<ShootingPlayApp> instances make disjoint edits (rename shot vs translate asset) and converge via MemoryBackbone with BOTH edits present on both sides.

**vcs/plugin/rs**: migrated VcsPlayApp to DocumentApp (Projection=VcsDemoProjection, Op=VcsDemoOp, unchanged domain/op vocabulary — it already had a proper Operation impl). Deleted VcsPlayEnvelope/store_from_envelope/sync_store_to_envelope/materialized_projection/set_document_op. History actions (undo/redo/commitCheckpoint/createAlternative/switchAlternative/checkoutCheckpoint) now fully handled by the wrapper's auto-interception — none reimplemented. render_history/build_document_tree now read from DocumentView.history (HistoryView) instead of the raw envelope. 13 tests pass.

**Framework contract additions (small, additive, backward-compatible)**:
- `DocumentApp::seed(&self, store: &mut DocumentVcsStore<...>)` (default no-op) in framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs — new one-time hook called from `VcsDocumentApp::new`, needed because vcs-demo's whole point is a pre-seeded rich checkpoint/alternative history and the contract had no way to inject that beyond a bare `initial_projection`.
- `VcsDocumentApp::projection(&self) -> Result<Projection, String>` in framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs — public typed-projection accessor; the existing `test_projection()` was `pub(crate)` to framework-plugin only, invisible to downstream plugin crates' own test modules (a real gap now that WS-F is the first external consumer).
- ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs: added missing re-exports (MeasureSelectItem, WindowEngagementPossible, WindowEngagementStatus) — pre-existing broken export path (unrelated to this ticket) that blocked shooting-plugin/vcs-plugin from compiling at all.
- Root Cargo.toml: added shooting/rs, shooting/plugin/rs, vcs/plugin/rs as workspace members (previously absent, so `cargo build -p` couldn't resolve them).

**Verification**: cargo test -p shooting (11 ok), -p shooting-plugin (27 ok, incl. convergence proof), -p vcs-plugin (13 ok). cargo build --workspace best-effort scan: only pre-existing unrelated failure is `protocol-plugin` (an old-style plugin awaiting a later WS-F wave, untouched by this ticket).

**Feedback for waves 2-4**: (1) Operation::author_id() defaults to "local" unless overridden per-op — CadOp doesn't override it either, so cross-actor UndoPolicy foreign-edit classification is currently a no-op for every migrated plugin; a real cross-instance convergence test needs a neutral pump trigger (e.g. commitCheckpoint) instead of undo, since undo would misclassify a just-received remote edit as local and pop it. (2) Coalesce keys only matter for continuous mid-gesture actions — confirmed via the renderer that gumball translate/rotate/scale dispatch once per whole drag already (atomic), only orbit-camera setCamera streams continuously; don't add coalesce_key to already-atomic actions. (3) HistoryView/HistoryColumn has no alternative-name field, only ids — any app needing a human-readable alternatives list (like vcs-demo) has to label by id or track names itself.

Note: an earlier ticket_close call omitted `path` and accidentally closed+overwrote the unrelated "Refactor and Extend Mathematical Crates" ticket's summary; this was caught immediately and fully reverted via `git restore` before this correct close.
